sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of riociguat during breastfeeding. Because riociguat is 95% bound to plasma proteins, the amount in milk is likely to be low. The manufacturer recommends that breastfeeding be avoided during riociguat use. The drug should be absent from breastmilk 3 days after the last dose.
